text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, about Puck? Yes, I guess you would be curious.
There don't seem to be any beings like him in this world...
choice_data_list: It's amazing how he's a singing, dancing idol kitty!
It's amazing how he's a great spirit!
It's amazing how a cat can fly and talk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
パックのこと？　
うん、
やっぱり気になるわよね。
こっちの世界だと
似た存在もいないみたいだし……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
Yes, he may be cute and love to joke, but he is a powerful spirit.
Still, I hope you'll be friends with him anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごーく可愛くて
気さくだけど、
立派な精霊なのよ。
でも、
仲良くしてあげてくれると嬉しいな。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Puck, you say the silliest things.
It's true he can sing and dance, but an \"idol kitty\"?
Where does he come up with these ideas?
text_block_list.orig_text:
パックったら、
またそんな冗談言って。
歌って踊れるのはホントだけど、
あいどる猫って、
変なことばっかりなんだから……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
He's not actually a cat at all,
but spirits seem to be rare in Landosol,
so I can see why you'd think that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントは猫じゃないんだけど、
ランドソルだと精霊は珍しいみたいだから
仕方がないのかな。
